name: Assisted Ascension [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your practiced skill at scaling heights as a team helps you aid others in their ascension.

Prerequisite(s): Climb 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you succeed at a Climb check, allies within 20 feet climb 5 feet along the same surface as an immediate action. You gain a +5 bonus on Climb checks to catch any falling ally who also has this feat.
